title: Hearty Charred French Asparagus Gratin
description: A charred, shaggy, romantic French dish featuring asparagus and bonito shave, perfect for a dairy-free friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the asparagus with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until the asparagus is evenly coated.
Spread the asparagus out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 12 minutes, or until slightly charred.
While the asparagus is roasting, combine the bonito flakes, garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
After the asparagus has roasted for 12 minutes, remove it from the oven and sprinkle the bonito flake mixture evenly over the top.
Return the asparagus to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 2 minutes, or until the bonito flakes are crispy and fragrant.
Remove the asparagus from the oven and sprinkle with nutritional yeast and chopped parsley.
Serve the asparagus hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
